tha-ap63:1.1: Vījanīvaggo chaṭṭamo. [VII. SAKACITTANIYAVAGGO.] [61. Sakacittaniya.] Pavanaṃ kānanaṃ disvā a*ppasaddaṃ a*nāvilaṃ / isīnaṃ anuciṇṇaṃ va āhutīnaṃ paṭiggahaṃ // //
tha-ap63:2.1: Thūpaṃ katvāna veḷūnaṃ nānāpupphaṃ samokiriṃ / sammukhā viya sambuddhaṃ nimmitaṃ abhivandi 'haṃ. // //
tha-ap63:3.1: Sattaratanasampanno rājā raṭṭhasmiṃ issaro / sakakammābhiraddho 'haṃ thūpapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap63:4.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhiropayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi thūpapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap63:5.1: Asītikappen' antayaso cakkavatti ahos' ahaṃ / sattaratanasampanno *catudīpamhi issaro* // //
tha-ap63:6.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sāsanan
tha-ap63:7.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Sakacittaniyo thero imā gāthāyo{abhāsitthā} ti.
